newsitem.title: USA: Oak Hill, Keystone form $1.75 bln investment fund.
newsitem.headline: Oak Hill, Keystone form $1.75 bln investment fund.

text.p: Oak Hill Partners Inc and Keystone Inc, formerly known as Robert M. Bass Group Inc, said Wednesday they formed a $1.75 billion investment partnership.
The new partnership, Oak Hill Securities Fund LP, will invest in high yield securities, bank loans, distressed securities and other investments.
The partnership's capital structure consists of $400 million of equity capital, a $1.2 billion revolving bank facility and $150 million of subordinated debt.
The partnership retained Oak Hill Advisors Inc as its exclusive investment advisor.
The principals of Oak Hill Advisors manage about $1.0 billion of securities investments for Acadia Partners LP.
The $400 million of equity capital has been provided by more than 35 institutional and individual investors.
The $1.2 billion bank facility, co-arranged by Chase Securities Inc and Wells Fargo Bank, includes a syndicate of 19 domestic and international banks.
The $150 million of 8.31 percent secured subordinated notes was privately placed by Chase Securities Inc, Jefferies & Co Inc, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp, and NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc.
